title: Ajisai canonical outcome registry
description: The complete outcome space: every NIL reason a Word's projection can answer with, and every error category a failed evaluation can carry. spec/words.json's projection.reason and errorWhen values are drawn from this registry; scripts/check-outcome-registry.mjs projects the Rust NilReason and ErrorCategory enums from it and fails if either side names something the other does not.

id.description: The lowerCamelCase protocol spelling. Mirrors NilReason::as_protocol_str() in rust/src/error.rs exactly — one entry per Rust variant, no more, no fewer.

projectable.description: true when a Word's own projection (spec/words.json's projection.reason) can answer with this reason. false for a reason a value carries for some other cause than a Word projecting it — currently only `literal`, which a NIL written in source or inside a vector literal carries, not a Word.

documentation.description: One sentence: what well-formed condition this reason names.

id.description: The lowerCamelCase protocol spelling. A `structural` id mirrors one of ErrorCategory's fixed variants (rust/src/error.rs); a `declared` id has no such variant and is reachable only through ErrorCategory::Declared(&str), carrying a spec/words.json errorWhen string verbatim. The two kinds are not disjoint from words.json's own errorWhen field: a `structural` id may also appear there, when the condition a Word declares is exactly the one its own fixed error variant already raises.

documentation.description: One sentence: what condition this category names.
